content:
maya: quick RFC follow-up: propose carving the "helix" runtime into three focused modules (ingest, core-exec, telemetry) + a thin orchestration facade. goals: independent deploys, clearer SLAs, smaller ownership.

sam: incremental or big-bang?

maya: incremental. plan: 1) extract readonly interfaces + tests, 2) compatibility shim, 3) route small traffic via flags, 4) ramp, retire old paths.

chris: KV cache ownership was a mess last time. what's the plan?

maya: keep KV in core-exec to start. expose narrow RPC for prefix hints. move ownership later if safe. minimizes cross-service transactions during cutover.

raj: observability is critical. we need end-to-end traces before routing any production traffic. canary with enforced tracing + latency histograms only.

kelly: product mandate: no customer-visible perf regressions. set module SLOs and overall budget.

maya: suggested SLOs: ingest p50 < 15ms, core-exec p50 < 40ms, telem p99 < 200ms. overall p50/p99 must not worsen. auto-fallback to monolith on breach.

sam: auto-fallback via router policy + circuit breaker watching errors and latency. I can implement that.

chris: kernel selection is stateful. avoid divergence by packaging kernel selector as a shared internal library used by both monolith and core-exec. version it. CI integration tests to detect drift.

raj: DB schema assumptions worry me. the monolith hides a few implicit invariants.

maya: keep single schema initially. use service-owned namespaces for new columns. reads/writes behind feature flags. rollback stays compatible.

sam: deployment cadence: modules should roll independently. need per-module release windows early to catch issues.

kelly: product wants a 6-week pilot and a rollback playbook.

maya: week-by-week plan: week0 design + owners, weeks1-2 extract interfaces, package kernel selector, add tracing hooks, week3 deploy core-exec behind flags to 5% with full tracing, week4 ramp to 25% + tuning + circuit-breakers, week5 telemetry validation + rollback drills + ramp to 60%, week6 cutover non-critical tenants + start deprecating monolith paths.

sam: add SRE/observability gates end of week3 and week5.

raj: I'll draft the observability gating checklist: traces, latency histograms, tail mitigation, error budgets, synthetic tests.

chris: security: enforce tenant isolation, mTLS between modules, short-lived tokens, no plaintext IPC. add KMS access for module secrets.

maya: agreed, include mTLS + token rotation in security workstream.

kelly: dependencies: runtime, router, infra for mTLS, and deploy tooling. I'll coordinate cross-team blockers and customer outreach.

deploy-bot: deployment: core-exec:canary started for 5% traffic on cluster-2 (job id: deploy-1768230123) :rocket:

sam: next steps: finalize RFC, assign owners, SRE to create gating checklist, infra to scope mTLS, I'll create follow-up tickets.

maya: tagging @raj @chris for checklists. reconvene after week1 quick sync. :thumbsup:
